# Captain preferences

<!-- memory tiers: see the stow skill -->

## Editorial rules for this file
- Domain portability: never hardcode fleet domains; refer to "this server's Cloudflare zone", rendered from the chezmoi `fleet.dnsDomain` variable.
- Path portability: use `~` or `$HOME`, never absolute home paths (`/home/<user>`).

## Infrastructure
- Cloudflare tunnels on this server's zone (phillias.cc) are managed CLOUD-SIDE ONLY: ingress changes go through the Zero Trust dashboard (connectors run token-mode/remotely-managed and hot-reload), never by editing server-side cloudflared configs or restarting those daemons. SSH through those tunnels is the critical path for fleet administrative access; a blip or misconfiguration there can sever it. (set 2026-08-22)
- Godoxy/reverse-proxy config changes and restarts: captain handles personally; agents never touch godoxy config without explicit per-task approval. (set 2026-08-25)
- Fallback / model-routing policy: owned by `~/.agents/skills/opencode-config/references/DESIGN.md` (§2.6) — read and update it there; never duplicate its details here. (set 2026-08-27)
- Hermes model routing: Hermes uses `opencode-proxy` provider → proxy (port 18090) → opencode server (42069) → zen Console tier, to avoid FreeUsageLimitError on the chain-primary model. Config: `~/.hermes/config.yaml` provider=opencode-proxy, systemd drop-in for env vars. Proxy is fragile (session accumulation vs no-subscriber hang); needs event-stream fix. (set 2026-08-18)
- Gate agent + node stack: no-mistakes gate agent is pi (upstream #633). Working `pi` bin is @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@0.84.2, pinned in mise config.toml (PR #216/217). Node via mise (`mise use -g node@22`), `~/.local/bin/node` symlinked for the daemon PATH; hermes uses the same node. Merge posture for gated mybrain PRs: captain approves merges; hermes waits for the word. (set 2026-08-24)
- Gate auth: gate repos use SSH origin via the `~/.ssh/config` `github.com` block first; HTTPS with the `gh auth git-credential` helper only if absolutely necessary. No ssh-agent, no systemd drop-ins, no ephemeral socket paths. pi API keys go in `~/.pi/agent/auth.json` (0600 perms); no plaintext secrets in systemd unit files. (set 2026-08-16)

## Working style
- Prefers free or near-free tooling and is wary of cloud-vendor lock-in; weigh cost before recommending paid or cloud capabilities. (set 2026-08-26)
- Prefer axi skills (gh-axi, chrome-devtools-axi, lavish-axi, quota-axi, chezmoi-axi, mem) over exec-ing out to raw CLIs; they are the agent-ergonomic surface for those tools. (set 2026-08-27)
- Prefer local skill references (e.g. `~/.agents/skills/*/references/`) over web fetching when the material exists locally; check the filesystem first. (set 2026-08-26)
- Automated config sync must run non-interactively: use the wrapper (chezmoi-axi), never a bootstrap, rugged for no-TTY, no user interaction, failing gracefully. (set 2026-08-26)
- Dotfiles changes (REVISED 2026-09-02, post-forensics): disable the chezmoi sync crontab before editing source, then edit → chezmoi re-add → no-mistakes PR to phillias/dotfiles (base master), and re-enable the crontab after the PR ships. The repo's .no-mistakes.yaml zeroes every auto_fix step — findings on dotfiles always escalate: approve, fix by finding ID, or skip individually; never a blanket --action fix. ask-user findings follow the high-blast-radius escalation line below. Merge is the captain gate. After each merge: validate → fast-forward local master → branch cleanup. Canonical source is ~/.local/share/chezmoi only — no separate checkouts. (set 2026-09-02; supersedes the same-day propose-only directive after forensics conclusively exonerated the no-mistakes pipeline — its last activity was 06:17:48, four hours before the 10:43–11:22 wipe; the failure vector was driver-layer authorization, now covered by the escalation lines)
- ask-user findings on high-blast-radius work — repos whose apply target or production surface touches the fleet (dotfiles, mybrain data, infrastructure repos) — always escalate to the captain; never self-decided under ask-user-authority, never blanket-authorized with a single --action fix. (set 2026-09-02, from the 02:51 keys-migration authorization)
- Do not track machine-generated artifacts in dotfiles (no-mistakes daemon unit, bun.lock). (set 2026-08-25)
- Git history surgery on upstream-managed installs (reset --hard etc.): state explicitly what lives inside vs outside the repo and what could be lost before executing — captain wants data-safety guarantees up front. (set 2026-08-25)

- Cheapest-lane dispatch: Firstmate spawn selection runs cost-aware — when multiple lanes qualify for a task, prefer the cheapest qualified lane; policy lives in the provider-catalog skill (`~/.agents/skills/provider-catalog`, `references/PROVIDERS.md`, "Cheapest-qualified-lane dispatch rule"), snapshot rates in that skill's `models.snapshot.json` / `PROVIDERS.md` — never duplicate rate numbers here. (set 2026-09-01)

## Task capture
- Proactively create a backlog task for any non-trivial work — anything requiring more than one step, any investigation, any design decision, or any deliverable worth tracking — using descriptive headline-style titles readable at a glance in the todo pane; mirror backlog items into that pane at every dispatch, completion, decision, and heartbeat (queued→pending, under way→in_progress, blocked→in_progress with the blocker noted, done→completed) and re-seed at session start — the pane is a presentation mirror of `data/backlog.md`, never an authority. (set 2026-08-27)

## Knowledge Portability Directive
- Trigger: any update to `data/learnings.md`, `data/captain.md`, or `data/projects.md`.
- Action: immediately run `axi-memory-add` with the same title and a concise summary of the body.
- Purpose: knowledge searchable and available from every server in the fleet. (set 2026-08-27)

# Fleet-local learnings (curated; concise-current)
<!-- memory tiers: see the stow skill -->

## Provider/chain stack (current as of 2026-09-02; owner: provider-catalog skill)
- **npm distribution done**: `@masculinecache/quota-axi@0.1.30` published on npmjs,
  pinned in the dotfiles mise manifest (retired the old stock-package+overlay
  hack entirely — never overlay again; mise + npm own updates). Public repo:
  https://github.com/masculinecache/quota-axi (scrubbed history, squash-root
  07f3463, authored noreply@firstmate.local). Internal dist hub bare:
  /home/ubuntu/quota-axi-bare.git (branch `blackwashed` holds pre-scrub history). <!--g-->
- All gh ops for quota-axi need `GH_CONFIG_DIR=$HOME/.config/gh-masculinecache`;
  the repo's credential helper is the llpoa pattern (blank reset + pool helper;
  the blank reset must be its own accumulated entry or global phillias wins). <!--g-->
- **Interactive chains** (opencode-fallback.jsonc, 14 chains; pi default chain
  `fallback/default`; hermes `~/.hermes/config.yaml` fallback_providers) =
  GLM-5.1 ladder: big-pickle → opencode-go/glm-5.1 → commandcode/zai-org/
  GLM-5.2 → openrouter/z-ai/glm-5 → opencode-zen/glm-5.1. PGS, Cloudflare
  Workers, Z.AI lite, gemini all retired from interactive (captain 09-01).
  Artistry is the exception lane: opencode-zen/gemini-3.5-flash (non-CF visual). <!--g-->
- **Pi gate chain**: `fallback/gate` via pi-fallback-provider (retry semantics:
  429/5xx/timeout retryable, 400/401/403 non-retryable + 5min provider
  cooldown). Parallel lane (#252/#253) put cerebras gpt-oss-120b at head,
  NIM nemotron-3-super promoted primary; the interactive GLM-5.1 ladder does
  not touch the gate key. gemini-2.5-flash is the gate tail. Gate model
   performance: gemini-led review steps ~2.5-5h with prose-JSON parse
   failures; nemotron-head steps run measurably faster. <!--g-->
- **pi models.json schema trap (2026-09-11, breaks the gate)**: pi 0.84.2's
  ProviderConfigSchema requires `models` to be an ARRAY of ModelDefinition
  objects (`{id, name, ...}`); the 2026-09-04 dynamic-route wiring added
  `cf-aig-dynamic` with `models: {"dynamic/TUI": {...}}` RECORD form. ModelConfig
  load then errors ("Invalid models.json schema: providers.cf-aig-dynamic.models:
  must be array") and the runtime discards the provider SILENTLY in headless mode
  — pi then reports `Model not found: cf-aig-dynamic/dynamic/pr-gate` from the
  fallback chain, killing no-mistakes review steps for any gate that pins a
  cf-aig-dynamic model. Interactive TUI harnesses unaffected (they don't use pi).
  Fix shape: `[{"id":"dynamic/TUI","name":"..."},...]`. Source of truth:
  `private_dot_pi/private_agent/models.json.tmpl` in dotfiles; fix must land in
  BOTH live ~/.pi/agent/models.json and the chezmoi source. <!--P-->
- **pr-gate streaming stall (2026-09-11, FIXED)**: after the array fix, pi review
  still hung — STREAMING via compat to dynamic/pr-gate stalled while non-stream
  200s came back ~35s; lane probes showed nvidia-nim super streams fine via its
  lane (1.1s), openrouter/luna fine (1s), openrouter nemotron:free lane STALLS,
  PGS glm-5.3-flash fine (3.1s), TUI (glm-5.3-flash) fine. Root cause: the
  pr-gate route graph bit off stalled streaming lanes first and the universal
  router emitted no byte while CF per-lane 30s timeouts stacked. Fix: route
  graph reordered via the AI Gateway REST API (grant: token
  ~/.agents/keys/.cf-ai-gw-token, NEVER printed; API mechanics: GET
  routes/{id}, POST .../routes/{id}/versions {elements:[...]}, POST
  .../routes/{id}/deployments {version_id}; no PUT, route edits are
  version+deploy). New order head = custom-phoenixgrove/glm-5.3-flash (verified
  streaming), then nim super, openrouter nemotron:free, luna, commandcode
  zai/GLM-5.2 + luna + nemotron-550b + Kimi-K3 + deepseek, zen gemini-3.5-flash
  (paid), google gemini-2.5-flash tail. Lane minimax/minimax-m3:free DROPPED
  (404 on probe; likely catalog-archived). pi fallback provider 10s first-byte
  abort was raised to 60s then REVERTED to 10s on captain order; pi smoke
  through fallback/gate now returns gate-ok end-to-end (~35s). <!--P-->
- **pirate SSH access (2026-09-11)**: chezmoi-deploy-key can't be shared ("key
  is already in use" — GitHub forbids one deploy key on two repos). Fresh
  `~/.ssh/pirate-deploy-key` generated + registered READ-ONLY deploy key on
  phillias/pirate (key id 162990490), verified live. Live wiring:
  `~/.ssh/config` `Host github.com-pirate` alias + projects/pirate origin
  switched to `git@github.com-pirate:phillias/pirate.git`. NOTE: the ssh config
  entry is live-only for now — dotfiles dot_ssh/config.tmpl is the tracked
  source of truth; mirror it on the next dotfiles PR or the next chezmoi apply
  reverts it. <!--g-->
- Gate does not log which chain model served each step (observability gap);
  `no-mistakes axi logs --step <s>` has forbidden `python` and vuln-scan
  commands from execution (per <pr-231> text). xvfb-screenshot blocked with
  fgbg backends. <!--g-->

## PGS (Phoenix Grove) facts (2026-08-30)
- Plan key IS valid for chat (direct 200); `GET /v1/usage` rejects plan pgsk_
  keys with invalid_api_key under every header variant. The real usage surface
  is the app's Supabase session RPC (api_plan_usage_summary etc., btncuytm;
  web-session credential class — forbidden for quota-axi; same verdict as zen
  console billing). PGS coding plan covers deepseek-v4-flash-0731 +
  glm-5.3-flash with a small daily window and burns credits — that's why PGS
  left the ladders. quota-axi's phoenixgrove provider reports
  key-valid-usage-denied when a 1-token chat probe succeeds (v0.1.30 polish). <!--g-->

## Dotfiles change flow (captain-established)
- Dotfiles changes go through the LIVE `~/.local/share/chezmoi` source
  directly; fresh dotfiles clones on primary are unwanted (run_* hazards).
  Disable the sync cron BEFORE source edits, ship via gate to PR, re-enable
  after PR creation. Future disables: REMOVE the line to /tmp backup and
  restore from it — comment-prefix wraps collapsed to treble nesting once. <!--g-->
- chezmoi-axi sync cron: every 30 min, stamps start/end + exit code, rotates
  log at 512KiB. <!--g-->
- SSH github.com gotcha (fixed upstream in #239): the kali
  id_ed25519_inspironkali key is passphrase-protected + unregistered; listing
  it BEFORE chezmoi-deploy-key hangs fresh shells on fetch prompts. Keep the
  deploy key first in the managed config. node22 path, pi needs node ≥22 —
  mise installs node22 + ~/.local/bin/node on daemon PATH. <!--g-->
- chezmoi naming: private_ prefixes are permission attributes, not path text. <!--g-->

## no-mistakes + dotfiles mechanics (stable)
- daemon: local git proxy validating pushes, owns async pipeline runs
  (state.sqlite, worktrees); CI monitor babysits PRs via hashed systemd unit
  (keep untracked in dotfiles). Gate bare repo = HTTPS + gh credential helper.
  Gate runs cost ~10-30 model calls; multi-hour runs are the norm with big-
  context models; document step routinely re-syncs duplicate doc claims. <!--g-->
- mybrain (phillias/mybrain) is gated: `.no-mistakes.yaml` lint = ruff check . <!--g-->
- npm publish 2FA: EOTP for write-required accounts; granular tokens do NOT
  bypass it — the token must be re-minted to bypass, or the account's 2FA
  scope relaxed ("authorization only"). <!--g-->
- mise: `npm.shell_out = true` stays (per-tool allow_low_downloads broken —
  aube writes an empty .npmrc; mise discussion 12424). npm alias dirs
  (0.1.24/0.1/0/latest) each hold one real package; overlay changed nothing
  for version gates — reading `--version` walks to installed package.json. <!--g-->
- OpenCode session stream-abort = context overflow: fresh sessions work,
  oversized sessions abort mid-stream with no ERROR logs; do NOT resume such
  sessions (compaction also fails); pull history from opencode.db directly. <!--g-->

## Selfhost + fleet pointers
- Godoxy: fileserver route roots resolve INSIDE the container (only
  selfhost/godoxy mounted; symlinks don't pass) — copy artifacts into
  selfhost/godoxy/data/. Route-file top-level key IS the hostname. Details:
  the selfhost skill owns godoxy. <!--g-->
- Hermes provider add procedure: append key to ~/.hermes/.env (0600), add
  providers: block in ~/.hermes/config.yaml, mirror in fallback_providers
  with base_url + api_mode, restart hermes-gateway; verify `hermes fallback
  list` + one-shot. Hermes logs its web workspace upstream as
